email.subject: Bit -- Vindication
email.body:
This is exactly what I was hoping for. The place has been stripped clean, but for one encrypted file in Bit's folder (as you've probably seen), but that file... I know how to open it, It's a password he told a few of us a long time ago that worked on a project with him. He sent us a message encrypted like this back then too.
The password's "divingsparrow" - I've already read it. There's an email account I need to check out now too - I suggest you do the same. Download the file and decrypt it locally, don't leave an open copy of that lying around. And contact me afterwards - it feels like we're reaching the truth - and some action.
Contact me once you've caught up, and lets finish this.
-V
